decisions: The ResurrectionCandidate contract now carries the seven blueprint fields: historical idea, historical failure reason, blocking constraint, current evidence, constraint change, new feasibility and bounded confidence.
Extraction accepts explicit metadata fields or deterministic text evidence; a text candidate requires historical failure, an identified cause, current evidence and an explicit feasibility signal.
Candidates without current evidence, or text explicitly saying there is no evidence of a constraint change, are rejected. No disappeared constraint is asserted without evidence.
The implementation remains provider-neutral and performs no network calls; the FREE_NETWORK registry classification does not authorize external access during this local task.
remaining_risks: Text extraction is English and cue-based; structured metadata is the reliable path for domain-specific terminology.
resurrection_confidence is a deterministic evidence-coverage heuristic, not a calibrated probability.
limitations: No network, external dependencies, database writes or production artifacts were used.
